title: First name is required
why: Confirms that a blank first name is rejected even when everything else is valid.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with FirstName '' (a blank value, and a second attempt with only spaces). LastName Meyer, Email anna.meyer@example.com, UserName anna.meyer, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Rejected with a validation error naming FirstName as required. No User row is created.
